passage.title: Teacher-written model response for TGA
paras: The notebook was still in the drawer, exactly where I had left it. Its cover had faded to the colour of weak tea, and the elastic band had given up years ago. I did not open it at first. I knew what was inside: every promise I had written at fourteen, in handwriting that still believed in everything.
